classes.read: query_type = 'select' OR was_cached = 1 (result-cache hits are logged as query_type='other')

ephemeral_id_clusters.definition: clusters with >= 1000 distinct user_ids over the 3 months (class 'all'); reported only as a sensitivity exclusion

fp_repeat_frac.definition: queries whose effective feature_fingerprint already occurred earlier in the same cluster's stream of this class (first occurrence = new) / queries of the class with non-NULL effective fingerprint

fp_repeat_frac_from_apr1.definition: same as fp_repeat_frac but numerator and denominator restricted to queries arriving on/after 2024-04-01 (March used only as look-back history, reduces start-of-log censoring)

distinct_fp_per_100.definition: 100 x distinct effective fingerprints / fingerprinted queries of the class (= 100 x (1 - fp_repeat_frac))

top10_fp_share.definition: queries whose fingerprint is one of the cluster's 10 most frequent fingerprints (within the class) / fingerprinted queries of the class

distinct_fp_per_100q_block.definition: mean number of distinct fingerprints in consecutive non-overlapping blocks of 100 fingerprinted queries (cluster stream order, class-filtered; incomplete last block dropped); denominator = number of blocks; eligibility for x-cluster: >= 10 blocks

fp_null_frac.definition: queries of the class whose effective fingerprint is NULL / queries of the class

cached_frac.definition: queries with was_cached = 1 / queries of the class

aborted_frac.definition: queries with was_aborted = 1 / queries of the class

sys_table_frac.definition: queries with effective num_system_tables_accessed > 0 / queries of the class (unknown counts treated as 0)

sys_only_frac.definition: queries with effective num_system_tables_accessed > 0 AND num_permanent_tables_accessed = 0 AND num_external_tables_accessed = 0 (NULL treated as 0) / queries of the class

xuser_same_fp_60s.definition: fingerprinted queries q for which another query of the same class, same cluster, same effective fingerprint and a DIFFERENT user_id arrived within [t_q - 60 s, t_q + 60 s] / fingerprinted queries of the class

xuser_same_fp_10s.definition: as xuser_same_fp_60s with a +/-10 s window

suser_same_fp_60s.definition: fingerprinted queries q for which ANOTHER query (not q itself) of the same class, cluster, effective fingerprint and the SAME user_id arrived within +/-60 s / fingerprinted queries of the class

suser_same_fp_10s.definition: as suser_same_fp_60s with a +/-10 s window

fp_first_seen_other_user_frac.definition: fingerprinted queries whose fingerprint's first occurrence in the cluster's class stream was issued by a different user_id / fingerprinted queries of the class

fp_first_seen_other_user_frac_of_repeats.definition: same numerator / repeated fingerprinted queries (rn > 1) of the class

principal_distinct_days.definition: per (cluster,user_id) principal: number of distinct calendar dates (arrival_timestamp::DATE) with >=1 query of the class; quantiles over principals

principal_span_days.definition: per principal: (last arrival - first arrival) in days; quantiles over principals

frac_principals_ge7_days.definition: principals active on >= 7 distinct days / principals

share_queries_by_principals_ge7_days.definition: queries of the class issued by principals active on >= 7 distinct days / queries of the class

share_queries_by_single_day_principals.definition: queries of the class issued by principals active on exactly 1 day / queries of the class

xcluster_cluster_median_principal_days.definition: per cluster: median over its principals of distinct active days; quantiles across clusters

xcluster_frac_principals_ge7_days.definition: per cluster: principals active on >= 7 distinct days / principals; quantiles across clusters

pooled_excl_ephemeral_id_clusters.definition: principal-level pooled stats excluding clusters with >= 1000 distinct user_ids

sessions.definition: per principal, queries of the class in stream order; a new session starts when the gap to the principal's previous query exceeds 30 min; duration = last - first arrival in the session (0 for 1-query sessions)
